architectural_decisions.rationale: To decouple the parts that make up the client-server model, the 3-layer architecture has been used.
For the development of the presentation layer, a logical architecture called Flux has been used.
NestJS has been decided to be used instead of popular alternatives like Express for its opinionated structure that allows creating complex REST APIs.
TypeORM has been decided to be used instead of accessing directly through SQL for its ease of use and its integration with NestJS.
AWS has been decided to be used instead of other alternatives like Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure for its popularity and its low cost.
This separation allows adding security to the system as the only public access is to the business service, which only contains the minimum information to understand the user's requests.
For better response speed of the system, there is a user cache system stored in Amazon DynamoDB, to which the business service has access.
This pattern is found in the Flux architecture, as the store notifies the views when its state changes.
